if: the goods or services or both are USED FOR PERSONAL CONSUMPTION
then: input tax credit is NOT AVAILABLE on them
note: Distinguish s.17(1), which RESTRICTS credit proportionately where use is partly business and partly other. This clause BLOCKS credit outright where the use is personal consumption. Same underlying idea, different mechanism, and the difference decides whether an apportioned amount survives. Section 17(5) opens 'Notwithstanding anything contained in sub-section (1) of section 16 and sub-section (1) of section 18', so this block defeats both the s.16(1) entitlement and the s.18(1) special-circumstances credit. Business use does not cure it. The source is the CGST Act as updated 31-08-2021. UNKNOWN whether a later amendment has changed this clause; later amendments are not held locally.
